name: Grimdark
description: A cruel world where every victory costs something.
tone: Bleak, brutal, and morally grey. Power corrupts, kindness is rare and costly, and nobody is safe. Hope exists but is never cheap.

narration.style: Spare and unflinching. Concrete physical detail, no melodrama. Let consequences land and stay.

artStyle: dark oil painting, heavy shadow, muted earth tones and oxblood
